title: Mitigating Biases of Large Language Models in Stance Detection with Counterfactual Augmented Calibration

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the standard deviation of recalls (RStd) on stance labels across different sentiment categories (positive, neutral, negative) to measure if the model erroneously relies on sentiment cues to predict a stance.

bias_targets.target: Target preference bias (Political and Social Topic bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the standard deviation of recalls (RStd) on stance labels across specific target entities and controversial topics (e.g., politicians like Joe Biden or Donald Trump, and issues like Legalization of Abortion or Gun Control) to evaluate inherent model preferences towards certain individuals or topics.

primary_bias_target: Stance bias (Spurious correlations and Target preference)
